entities.summary: Lee Henry Casciaro is a Gibraltarian footballer and police officer who plays as a forward for Lincoln Red Imps and the Gibraltar national team. With 60 titles won with Lincoln recognized by UEFA, he has the record for most titles with one club, most club titles, and most titles in association football. From 2019 to 2022, he was also Gibraltar's all-time leading scorer since joining UEFA, with three goals.
